name: Shotcut
summary: Edit video and audio on a timeline.
description: Shotcut is a cross-platform video editor built on the MLT multimedia framework. Codec, export and hardware-acceleration behavior require testing on the selected Windows package.

license.notes: Upstream license indicator only; redistribution, dependency notices and any model/asset licenses await legal review.

requirements.hardware: Media resolution and effects determine memory, GPU and disk demand; caches and exports need additional space.
requirements.disk: Unknown for a RepoReady distribution. Measure installer, installed files, working data and optional downloads before approval.
